name: QuizTime
author: Elvin
short: Periodic multiple-choice quiz with bank rewards and leaderboard
description: Posts periodic multiple-choice quiz questions to a configured channel. Uses Discord buttons for answers, awards Redbot bank currency to the first correct responder, and keeps a leaderboard. Questions and category images are stored in quiz.json.
install_msg: Thank you for installing QuizTime . Use the [p]quiztime command to see the help menu
